license_summary.trapping_license: No person shall set or run traps of any type to catch furbearers during the open trapping season without a current trapping license. A trapping license is also required to sell furbearer pelts or carcasses (bobcats cannot be pelted or sold without a trapping license).
license_summary.wma: On WMAs, trapping requires a self-clearing permit and WMA Access Permit, and trapping dates vary by individual WMA schedule.
license_summary.bobcat_otter_tagging: For bobcat and river otter, a special possession tag (red for bobcat, blue for river otter) must be filled out by the trapper when the pelt is first sold; no bobcat or river otter pelts may be shipped from Louisiana without an attached CITES tag.
